title: Import mistakes stop the import and are reported with their location
description:
## Behavior
Nothing half-imported: any problem stops the import, and says where.

```gherkin
Feature: Import mistakes are reported with their location

  Scenario: The file does not exist
    When I run "apricity import --markers nowhere.asd"
    Then the command fails with "nowhere.asd: no such file"

  Scenario: The sample was never analyzed
    Given "new.wav.asd" beside the unanalyzed "new.wav"
    When I import its markers
    Then the command fails with "new.wav has no analysis yet; run apricity-analyze new.wav"

  Scenario: The sidecar belongs to different audio
    Given a sidecar whose audio length is 12.0 s beside "steady-120.wav" (8.5 s)
    When I import its markers
    Then the command fails with "steady-120.wav.asd describes 12.0 s of audio but steady-120.wav is 8.5 s; is it the right file?"

  Scenario: Markers out of order
    Given an .asd whose 4th warp marker is before its 3rd
    When I import its markers
    Then the command fails with the file, the byte offset and "warp marker 4 (12.40 s, beat 7) is before marker 3 (12.52 s, beat 6)"
    And the sample's warp markers are unchanged

  Scenario: A marker beyond the end of the audio
    Given an .alc with a warp marker at 30.0 s for an 8.5 s sample
    When I import its markers
    Then the command fails naming the line, the marker and the sample's length

  Scenario: Warping is off in the DAW
    Given "free-time.alc" saved with warping off
    When I import its markers
    Then the command fails with "free-time.alc: warping is off in this clip; there are no warp markers to import"

  Scenario: An .asd version Apricity cannot read
    Given an .asd with an unknown version marker
    When I import its markers
    Then the command fails naming the version and suggesting to save the clip as an .alc and import that
```
